# Feature: Configurable Kanban Columns

## Overview
Allow users to rename, reorder, and show or hide the existing Kanban status columns from Settings, with the configuration persisted locally and shared by the board and task editors.

## User Stories
- As an administrator, I want to customize column names and order so the board matches my workflow.
- As a user, I want my column preferences to persist between sessions.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
- `client/src/pages/SettingsPage.jsx`: add a column configuration section with title inputs, visibility toggles, move controls, and reset.
- `client/src/utils/columnConfig.js`: define defaults, storage, validation, and a browser event for same-tab updates.
- `client/src/App.jsx`: load and pass the active column configuration to the board, task card, and task modal.
- `client/src/components/KanbanBoard.jsx`, `TaskCard.jsx`, and `TaskModal.jsx`: render and select from configured columns.
- `client/src/pages/SettingsPage.test.jsx`: cover persistence, editing, visibility, reordering, and reset.

### Data Model (Mock)
```json
[
  { "id": "TODO", "title": "To Do", "className": "column-todo", "visible": true, "order": 0 },
  { "id": "IN_PROGRESS", "title": "In Progress", "className": "column-in_progress", "visible": true, "order": 1 },
  { "id": "REVIEW", "title": "Review", "className": "column-review", "visible": true, "order": 2 },
  { "id": "DONE", "title": "Done", "className": "column-done", "visible": true, "order": 3 }
]
```

### Simulated Backend
No new API is required. Status IDs remain the Django-supported `TODO`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `REVIEW`, and `DONE` values; only client labels, order, and visibility are configurable. Hidden columns remain valid status choices and are still selectable in task forms.

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Add localStorage-backed configuration helpers with malformed-data fallback and a same-tab custom event.
2. Add Settings controls that preserve at least one visible column and keep IDs stable for API compatibility.
3. Pass active columns from `App` to board and task editing surfaces.
4. Filter board rendering by visible configured columns while keeping task status values valid.
5. Add focused Settings and board regression coverage.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Users can rename each supported column.
- [ ] Users can reorder columns and hide columns, while at least one column remains visible.
- [ ] Configuration persists in localStorage and updates the board without a reload.
- [ ] Reset restores the four default columns.
- [ ] Task status IDs remain compatible with the existing Django API.

## Dependencies
- **Internal**: React state, `SettingsPage`, `KanbanBoard`, task forms, and existing status constants.
- **External**: None.
